group.title: A room change around a meeting
group.passage:
Woman: The street noise kept me awake. My online meeting is at two this afternoon. Then I’ll be out until five.
Man: A quieter room will be ready at three. Our workroom is open from one to three.
Woman: I’ll move. I’ll leave both bags here, but I need the red one when I return.
Man: Tag each bag you want moved. Your new key is at reception until five, then at the night desk.
group.passageZh:
女：街上的噪音害我睡不著。今天下午兩點有線上會議，之後我會出門，到五點才回來。
男：比較安靜的房間三點會準備好。我們的工作室一點到三點開放。
女：那我換房。兩件行李都先放這裡，不過我回來時需要紅色那件。
男：需要搬到新房間的行李，請各掛一張標籤。新房卡五點前在接待櫃檯，之後到夜間櫃檯領。
